title: Pottstown Area Amateur Radio Club marks 50 years in Limerick
summary: The ham radio club, which grew out of a 1970s repeater team that met in a Pottstown High classroom, is celebrating its 50th anniversary with talks, licensing exams and weekly on-air nets.

title: Pottstown council asks residents about single-topic public workshops
summary: Borough council is gauging public interest in a six-month pilot of workshop-style sessions, each devoted to one pre-chosen topic, proposed by Councilman Raymond Rose as a way to hold more proactive conversations in public.

title: Phoenixville Fire Department to hire five full-time firefighters with FEMA grant
summary: The borough says its $974,561 federal SAFER award, matched with borough money, will pay for five new full-time firefighters. Phoenixville was one of only six Pennsylvania departments to win a SAFER grant this cycle.

title: Baithak Indian Cuisine opens in Spring City
summary: A new Indian restaurant, Baithak, has opened on the riverfront at 10 Riverside Dr., according to the Inquirer's Chester County roundup.

title: SCI Phoenix opens lottery for youth and veteran deer hunts
summary: The state prison in Skippack will host controlled antlerless deer hunts on its grounds: a junior hunt for ages 12-16 on Dec. 30 and a veteran and first-responder hunt on Jan. 20, with spots awarded by lottery to licensed hunters holding WMU 5C tags.

title: Route 23 Wawa near Phoenixville opens Thursday, Oct. 22
summary: The 24-hour super Wawa at 799 Valley Forge Rd. in Schuylkill Township, replacing a former Exxon after nearly a decade of debate, opens at 8 a.m. Thursday with free coffee through Sunday and a first-responder hoagie-building contest for charity.

title: Medal of Honor recipients to attend Valley Forge grove rededication Oct. 29
summary: Founding Forward will rededicate its 42-acre Medal of Honor Grove on its Valley Forge campus with new recipient plaques, four living recipients in attendance and a keynote by ABC's Martha Raddatz. The ceremony starts at 11 a.m. Thursday, Oct. 29.

title: Spring City Hotel restaurant set an Oct. 18 reopening under new management
summary: The Diable family has taken over the long-running restaurant at 88 N. Main St., with chef Tim Diable writing a new menu. A grand reopening is set for Sunday, Oct. 18 at 3 p.m., and the kitchen is still hiring.

title: $1 million state grant kicks off an all-abilities playground at Sanatoga Park
summary: Lower Pottsgrove broke ground on Adventure Grove, a $1.6 million inclusive playground that will replace the park's 23-year-old play equipment. Volunteers have been pushing for the project since 2019.

title: Chocolate & Coffee Festival returns to the Oaks expo center Oct. 24-25
summary: The third annual Pennsylvania Chocolate & Coffee Festival brings more than 150 vendors to the Greater Philadelphia Expo Center, with live coffee roasting, maker demos and a four-foot chocolate sculpture marking America's 250th.
